title: Senior Cloud Full Stack Developer

resumeText:
Alex Rivera
Summary: Passionate Full Stack Developer with 4 years building scalable web apps.

jobDescriptionText:
Job Title: Senior Cloud Full Stack Engineer
We are looking for a skilled engineer to join our core product team.
Requirements:
1. 4+ years of professional development experience with React.js and Node.js.
2. Strong demonstrated proficiency with TypeScript is required.
3. Experience with PostgreSQL and relational database design is required.
4. Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized deployments is mandatory.
5. Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure (EC2, S3) and CI/CD pipelines is strongly preferred.
